compatibility_lowering.description: Per-lane integer extensions retain the RC7 compatibility repair; all new shader sources are already lowered.

rc7_baseline.description: Per-lane sext/zext <2 x i16> to <2 x i32>; all packed arithmetic retained.

sdk_synchronization.description: Retain the SDK buffer-UAV addBarrier call for non-null bindings even when a compute job requests SKIP_BARRIERS; orders padding clears after the preceding model dispatch.
